title: Werkzeug multipart form-data directory traversal via unsanitized filename
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0931: Werkzeug multipart form-data directory traversal via unsanitized filename
Repository: `pallets/werkzeug`
Category: `Security Sandbox & Serialization Exploits`
Target File: `src/werkzeug/utils.py`

#### Problem Description
Secure_filename allows relative path components when filename contains Unicode directory separators.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Strip all path separators ('/', '\', and Unicode equivalents) and restrict to ASCII alphanumeric.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0931.py -q`
expected_invariant: Strip all path separators ('/', '\', and Unicode equivalents) and restrict to ASCII alphanumeric.
